races.paceDynamic: Top Jimmy and Swindon Village will contest the early lead, with Top Jimmy's aggressive style likely to dictate from the front. Nine prominent racers including Captain Teague, Joyeuse, and Wellington Arch will create significant traffic congestion approaching the final two hurdles, especially dangerous given Aintree's sharp turns. The honest gallop set by the front-runners will stretch the field, leaving hold-up horses like Indeevar Bleu and Favour And Fortune with work to do in the heavy ground. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid the mid-race scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Top Jimmy or Swindon Village gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear approaching the last two hurdles while prominent runners get trapped behind traffic. Hold-up horses have too much ground to make up in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong enough to soften up the leaders but not collapse the race
scenarios.body: Well-positioned prominent runners like Captain Teague and Joyeuse can time their challenges perfectly between the last two flights. The pace will be honest enough to find out the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroics
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes overly strong and the front-runners tie up dramatically
scenarios.body: The race falls apart in the final half-mile allowing classy hold-up horses to weave through tired horses. Indeevar Bleu and Favour And Fortune have the class to capitalize on this collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Special
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates a wall of horses that blocks normal progression
scenarios.body: An outsider positioned wide or a horse that finds the rail gets a clear run while favourites are shuffled back. The pace becomes secondary to track position and luck in running.

watchPoints.text: Top Jimmy and Swindon Village clash early could set up suicidal pace that destroys both leaders
Traffic jam developing between hurdles two and three out as nine prominent runners converge
Indeevar Bleu and Favour And Fortune need significant pace collapse to get competitive position

races.paceDynamic: Regent's Stroll and Miami Magic will set a solid tempo from the flag, with both natural front-runners having the pace to establish positions early over this demanding 3m1f trip. Gold Dancer and Jordans Cross will track the leaders prominently, while the hold-up merchants Salver and Wendigo will settle towards the rear as connections plan late strikes. The sustained gallop created by dual pace-setters over Aintree's stamina-sapping fences should produce a searching test that plays into the hands of strong-staying hold-up performers who can finish powerfully when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Profit
scenarios.trigger: If the dual pace-setters maintain a solid gallop throughout the contest
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo over 3m1f will stretch the field and create the perfect setup for late closers to sweep past tiring leaders in the final half-mile. Patient tactics from the rear will be rewarded as the race develops into a stamina test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Gold Dancer or Jordans Cross can secure ideal tracking positions behind the pace-setters
scenarios.body: These prominent runners can avoid the early speed battle while staying close enough to pounce when the leaders weaken, combining tactical positioning with finishing power. Their ability to travel strongly in behind gives them first strike on the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter can shake off their rival and control the tempo solo
scenarios.body: Miami Magic or Regent's Stroll could establish a decisive advantage by getting first run on the field and maintaining their gallop to the line. The winner would need to show superior stamina reserves to repel late challenges over the final two fences.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Mid-Division
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters go too fast early and completely fade from contention
scenarios.body: The tempo burns out the leaders and stretches the hold-up horses too far back, allowing a mid-division runner to inherit the race through superior positioning. This would require tactical errors from connections of the main contenders.

watchPoints.text: Wendigo showed signs of losing his jumping confidence when falling last time and could struggle with Aintree's unique fences

Salver's hold-up style requires the race to unfold ideally and any slow early pace would severely compromise his chances
Gold Dancer steps up significantly in trip and his ability to last the 3m1f distance remains unproven at this level

races.paceDynamic: Sober Glory and Sinnatra will contest the early lead, with Sober Glory likely to dominate given his superior class and consistent front-running form. The honest gallop these two will set should establish a solid pace over this 2m½f trip at Aintree. La Conquiere may track prominently in third, while the hold-up trio of Baron Noir, Starting Fifteen, and Storming George will need to time their challenges from off the pace. This setup clearly favours the front-runners and prominent racers, as the smaller field and dual pace angle should create an honest tempo that makes it difficult for hold-up horses to close effectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates

scenarios.body: His superior OR 153 rating and perfect record on similar going allows him to dictate terms and kick clear. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on a track that rewards those racing handy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Sober Glory and Sinnatra go too hard early and weaken significantly
scenarios.body: Baron Noir's proven Grade 1 ability and hold-up style becomes decisive as the early leaders fold. Starting Fifteen could also benefit from his fresh 68-day break if the pace collapses completely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If La Conquiere sits perfectly positioned behind the early battle
scenarios.body: His recent good form (2-1-1-2-0) and Jamie Snowden's 3/13 strike rate suggests he can capitalize from his ideal prominent position. The 7lb weight advantage over the top-rated horses becomes crucial in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and Starting Fifteen's fresh legs tell late
scenarios.body: His 68-day break could be a significant advantage if Sean Flanagan times his run perfectly from the rear. However, this requires the front-runners to set only a steady tempo, which seems unlikely given their styles.

races.paceDynamic: Gidleigh Park will set the early tempo unopposed from the front, creating a measured gallop early with the prominent brigade of Heart Wood, L'Eau du Sud, JPR One, Saint Segal and Solness tracking closely behind. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the leaders won't be softened up, allowing those prominent runners to remain competitive throughout. Grey Dawning sits as the sole hold-up performer in a small field where the pace may not collapse sufficiently. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can stay handy without doing excessive work early, then strike when the pace lifts approaching the business end.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and controlled as expected
scenarios.body: Heart Wood and L'Eau du Sud can stalk the leaders comfortably before asserting their superior class in the closing stages. The measured tempo suits horses who need to stay in touch without being asked hard questions early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Gidleigh Park gets away with soft fractions and isn't pressured until late
scenarios.body: The 83-day absence becomes irrelevant as Bryan Carver dictates terms throughout, with the short-priced favourites leaving their challenge too late. Harry Fry's minimal recent runners suggests this one has been specifically targeted.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Grey Dawning Times It Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and kicks late with a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Grey Dawning's hold-up style becomes an asset as Harry Skelton can produce the 9-year-old with a withering late burst. The Skelton team's excellent recent form provides additional confidence in execution.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse and Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Gidleigh Park goes too fast early or multiple prominent runners engage too soon
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and the race falls apart completely, allowing a horse from off the pace or one who drops out early to benefit. This scenario requires tactical errors from multiple jockeys.

races.paceDynamic: Il Est Francais, Ile Atlantique, Conflated, Mahons Glory, and Lisnamult Lad will ensure a fierce gallop from the start in this 30-runner cavalry charge. With 12 prominent racers including Matata, Viroflay, and Prairie Wolf fighting for position behind the leaders, severe traffic problems are inevitable approaching the business end. The relentless early pace combined with soft ground will stretch the field and expose stamina limitations over this extended trip. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses like Madara, Boombawn, and Booster Bob who can avoid the early scrimmaging and capitalize on the inevitable weakening of pace-pressed rivals.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the front-running sextet maintain their aggressive gallop through halfway
scenarios.body: The brutal early pace on testing ground will cause mass casualties among prominent runners, leaving the patient hold-up brigade with decisive stamina advantages in the closing stages. Clean runs permitting, the Skelton pair and other patient types can sweep past exhausted pace casualties.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Survives Scrum
scenarios.trigger: If one of the dozen prominent racers finds racing room and avoids interference
scenarios.body: The winner emerges from the mid-pack melee having tracked the pace without getting involved in the early burn. Prairie Wolf or Matata could prove tough enough to handle the traffic while maintaining finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the six front-runners go too fast too soon and begin backing up before the straight
scenarios.body: A mid-race slowdown allows the prominent brigade to close up and turn this into a sprint finish where class tells. The lack of early pace pressure suits those who need cover but have gears.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders finds an uncontested lead while the others battle
scenarios.body: Il Est Francais or Conflated could steal a march by avoiding the pack warfare while their pace-setting rivals compromise each other. The winner gets first run on the field from an isolated position.

scenarios.body: The relentless pace will drain the leaders and create perfect conditions for the hold-up horses to pick up the pieces in the final half-mile. Seaniecon and Harbour Island possess the tactical speed to capitalise when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early leader survives
scenarios.trigger: If Johnny's Jury or No Drama This End can dictate a more measured tempo early
scenarios.body: One of the classy front-runners can control the race and have enough left for a decisive move approaching the last two flights. Their superior class ratings give them the edge if not softened up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-race shake-up
scenarios.trigger: If several front-runners fall or make mistakes at the hurdles
scenarios.body: The race complexion changes dramatically with prominent runners like Mondoui'boy and Kripticjim finding themselves in ideal positions. They can avoid the early burn-up while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too fast and capitulate before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the back with Shadow Paddy's finishing kick becoming lethal despite his 174-day absence. Fresh legs triumph over race fitness in a slowly-run finale.

races.paceDynamic: Pourquoi Pas Papa will lead uncontested through the early stages, setting a sustainable gallop that won't stretch the field. Behind him, a wall of prominent runners including Sherminator, Harry Lowes, Captain Ryan Matt, Litleangel Duseuil, Static, and Wandering Ego will create serious congestion from 3 furlongs out as they all vie for position. The pace will quicken from the second-last hurdle as the prominent brigade jostle for room, likely causing interference and blocking runs for hold-up horses. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can secure early position and avoid the traffic carnage, while hold-up horses face a nightmare scenario with limited room to manoeuvre in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners secure good position early without interference
scenarios.body: The likes of Sherminator, Harry Lowes and Litleangel Duseuil can use their natural speed to dominate from ideal positions. Hold-up horses get trapped behind the wall of prominent runners and cannot find gaps when needed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the congested prominent pack causes multiple instances of interference 2-3 furlongs out
scenarios.body: Several prominent runners get hampered or blocked, opening the door for hold-up horses with clear runs like Star Of Guiting or The Mighty Celt. The pace becomes stop-start, suiting patient tactics over early speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Solo Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pourquoi Pas Papa gets an easy lead and the prominent pack fails to close effectively
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner uses his natural front-running ability to dictate terms and kick clear when the congested pack behind starts fighting each other. His soft ground form gives him the edge in testing conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the last
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses with strong finishing kicks like Wandering Ego or Laafi can produce late surges past a tiring field. The sustained pace never materialises, negating the prominent runners' positional advantage.
